objective: Nobody the profile route refuses is ever offered on the map or in Recently Active.
userOutcome: Tapping a person always opens a profile; a refused one is dropped before it can be tapped, and never shows an empty card.
successCriteria: Discovery measures the viewer from the encrypted envelope, as the profile route does, so the two agree on who is in range.
A 404 from the profile route removes that person from the map and Recently Active and never renders a card.
mustPreserve: Block behaviour, which the drop reuses.
nonGoals: No change to what a visibility rule means.

assumptions.statement: "That profile is unavailable." is the copy behind the report; the app has no deleted-profile copy.
assumptions.impact: The fix targets the list/route disagreement and the tap-on-refusal, not account deletion.

nextVisibleMilestone: No tappable refused profile on cruush.app.
stopConditions: Stop if the server build fails.
